name: Haus Margit
beschreibung: Haus Margit is located in a quiet yet central location in Serfaus, with views of the surrounding mountains. The accommodation offers several bedrooms and bathrooms, a living area with fireplace, and a fully equipped kitchen for self-catering. Dining is not offered at the house, but restaurants in the village are within walking distance. Nearby, hiking trails in summer and the ski slopes in winter invite guests to get active. The atmosphere of the house is characterized by the use of wood and natural materials, creating a calm and cozy mood. The amenities are geared toward self-caterers, allowing guests to organize their stay flexibly.
